finalText:
Migration finished. 36 call sites across 12 files converted from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the style of the already-migrated files (e.g. `packages/accounts/src/repo/user.js`).

**Files changed:**

| Package | Files |
|---|---|
| accounts | `repo/session.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`, `service/teamService.js` |
| billing | `repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js` |
| catalog | `repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js` |
| orders | `repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js` |
| analytics | `repo/cohort.js` |
| support | `repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js` |

**Verification:** `db.query` no longer appears anywhere in `packages/`, and `node --check` passes on every `.js` file in the repo. There are no tests in the repo to run.

**Two things I deliberately left alone:**

1. **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`** still has 2 `db.query` calls. Its header says it's a vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4, "Do not edit — it is replaced wholesale on every upgrade, and local changes are silently lost." Patching it would be reverted by the next upgrade. Since `lib/db.js` notes the driver's next major drops `query` entirely, this is a real blocker worth tracking separately — the fix is upstream in legacy-orm, or wrapping the vendored adapter with a shim that maps positional args onto `execute`. Say the word and I'll add the shim.

2. **`cache.query(...)` calls** (in the `cached*` helpers across ~20 repo files) are untouched — that's `lib/cache.js`, a different object with a single-key-lookup signature, unrelated to this migration.
